import re, os, sys

# usage: rewrite_paths.py <stage_dir> <orig_service_dir>
stage = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
orig = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[2])

# external deps: any original path-source target outside the original service dir
src_re = re.compile(r'(\[tool\.uv\.sources\.[\w\-]+\]\s*\n\s*path\s*=\s*)"((?:\.\./)+[^"]+)"')
79:    docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/rewrite_paths.py "$cd" "$corig" >> "$LOGS/relock.log" 2>&1 || true

observation.command: ps aux | grep -E 'orchestrate|docker build' | grep -v grep | head; echo ====; head -8 /workspace/.build-logs/rewrite_paths.py; grep -n 'rewrite_paths' /workspace/.build-logs/orchestrate.sh
